mu_name_from: _enum.h:1587 MODEL_DIVINE_CB_OF_ARCHANGEL = MODEL_BOW + 18, loaded from Item/Bow19.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:699), a crossbow by CharacterManager.cpp:81; group 4 number 18 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:234.
why_this_one: The third Statue of Saint (134) carries it over its coffin, at scale 0.9 where the other two are 0.7 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8952-8966; WebZen raises one of the three statues at random, BloodCastle.cpp:2216), and gives it up when broken; carried back to the Archangel it wins the castle, as the Divine Staff does. A quest item, worn by nobody. docs/blood-castle-port.md.

stats.from: OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:234: CreateWeapon(4, 18, 0, 24, 2, 3, false, "Divine Crossbow of Archangel", 100, 224, 246, 45, 200, 0, 0, 40, 110, ...) -- drop 100, 224-246, speed 45, elf.
stats.note: A quest item here, as the Divine Staff of Archangel (Staff11): the statue gives it up and the Archangel takes it back; nobody wears it, and its damage, requirements and class are left out so the card says none. OpenMU's row was drop 100, 224-246, elf; it does not drop from monsters.

stance_from: A crossbow by MU's own range test (CharacterManager.cpp:81, MODEL_DIVINE_CB_OF_ARCHANGEL to MODEL_GREAT_REIGN_CROSSBOW).
sheet_from: Data/Item/crossbow06_R.OZJ (32x64, the red crystal limbs, 112 triangles) and crossbow06.OZJ (16x64, the blue steel stock, 98). Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel, the paint its albedo. Not built, MuMain's effects: mesh 0, the red crystal, RENDER_METAL with BITMAP_CHROME sliding over it (ZzzObject.cpp:7054-7059); its held sparkles are commented out in MuMain (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7523-7539); fired, it would loose MODEL_ARROW_BEST_CROSSBOW (ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:231), which a quest item never is. A statue holds it at scale 0.9, AngleMatrix(10, 0, 0) and (0, 110, 80) (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6684-6699).
rig_note: No .rig.json: Bow19.bmd has one bone and one action of one key, nothing moves (export-rig --actions=all, 2026-10-03), and it is never drawn, so its string never draws back; a quest item needs only MU's geometry at action 0 key 0. No release, muzzle or bolt for the same reason.
material_overrides_note: As the Divine Staff's: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the scene.
tells: Reward received when returned to the Archangel
tells_from: MU's own sentence for the Archangel's weapon, Game.en.resx:3049; the 'Quest item' line over it is ours (game/ui/describe.cpp).
